method: A base is a free 500-seed window: no folder K<k>x<base> or W<seed> anywhere in rpp-v3 (records of runs 1 to 5, archives, side experiments) or in the --also folders (earlier engine runs), no base of any run 5 set, no excluded range (run 5's rules, v3.run5_sets.free_windows). Validation-split windows go to the open sets, train-split windows to the sealed ones, in round-robin order over problem families. Only each base's family is read; no item is built.
